items.title: FactSet Research Systems (FDS) Extends Debt Maturities And Expands $1.5 Billion Credit Line
items.summary: FactSet Research Systems (NYSE:FDS) has amended its existing credit agreement with PNC Bank, extending maturities on key loan facilities. The amendment adjusts the structure of FactSet’s credit facilities, affecting the mix between term debt and revolving liquidity.
